skills.name: spring-modular-scaffold
skills.description: Use when starting a new Spring Boot service and you want a modular architecture whose boundaries are enforced by the build rather than by convention — generates a buildable skeleton with layered modules, ArchUnit rules, documentation guards, and ADRs, with options for auth / persistence / parent distribution.

skills.name: module-acceptance-testing
skills.description: 为业务模块或服务客户端设计、实现、运行和复测可追溯的验收测试，产出P0/P1/P2用例、请求响应证据、分级报告及测试资源清理记录。用于“给这个模块写验收用例”“按记忆模块方式测试其他模块”“一键跑用例并生成报告”等请求；普通局部单元测试无需套用整套执行器。
